summary.text: Candace Greer is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 64 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Matt Hostettler.

paragraphs.text: Candace Greer advanced from the Democratic primary for District 64 on May 5, 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a working parent and said her key messages are that public school funding should go only to public schools, investment in rural infrastructure such as roads and hospitals, and protecting townships and low and fixed-income families from government consolidation.
